correctness.rationale: Exact formula (3) follows by expanding the m+n leaf and hub distance pairs. The two strictly negative internal sectors leave a symmetric 2-by-2 block; its determinant (4) has one root because both F factors decrease and the positive Delta term increases on p>1. For every p above that root the block has a positive direction; at the root its sole null direction is radial. Exact p=1 edge-cut identity plus p-negative-type inheritance proves all lower exponents. The strict log-sinh concavity proves the contrast derivative; fixed-exponent asymptotics prove the limit. Centered Gram rank gives Hilbert dimensions. A standard-library verifier checks 168 exact rational forms and 20 numerical spectral profiles; finite tests do not replace the analytic argument.

value.rationale: This solves a natural complete continuous-parameter weighted-star extension of the classical uniform-star negative-type problem, gives sharp real-exponent thresholds and critical affine dimension, and proves nonobvious geometric structure (strict improvement under length imbalance, length-swap invariance at unequal multiplicities, and an unattained approach to 2 for four leaves). The answers can inform sharp Hilbert snowflake embeddings and are neither a prescribed arbitrary slice nor a routine recomputation of a published table.
